0|a579086c99ed70cc4bfc104348dbe3dd8f2787e6|torvalds~linux|/home/usuario01/Titan-Files-Research/src/_00/output/C/torvalds~linux|False|"mm: multi-gen LRU: remove eviction fairness safeguard
Recall that the eviction consumes the oldest generation: first it
bucket-sorts folios whose gen counters were updated by the aging and
reclaims the rest; then it increments lrugen->min_seq.
The current eviction fairness safeguard for global reclaim has a
dilemma: when there are multiple eligible memcgs
or stop upon meeting the reclaim goal? If it continues
and increases direct reclaim latency; if it stops
between memcgs it has taken memory away from and those it has yet to.
With memcg LRU
stop upon meeting its goal. Therefore the current eviction fairness
safeguard for global reclaim will not be needed.
Note that memcg LRU only applies to global reclaim. For memcg reclaim
the eviction will continue
